result:
`app/inventory.py` has two real bugs, both where the code contradicts its own docstring; I did not run the tests, and no files were changed.

At `app/inventory.py:13`, `merge` does `total[sku] = qty`, which overwrites instead of summing, so a repeated SKU ends up with only its last quantity. The fix is `total[sku] += qty`.

At `app/inventory.py:19`, `low_stock` uses `qty < threshold`, but the docstring says "at or below", so a SKU sitting exactly at the threshold is missed. The fix is `qty <= threshold`.

A smaller concern is `value` at `app/inventory.py:24`: it raises a bare `KeyError` for any stocked SKU with no price. It also sums floats before rounding, which can be off by a cent if prices are not `Decimal`. Whether either matters depends on how callers use it.
